title: Concept: Meta tag delivers a CSP frame-ancestors directive a browser ignores
description: Several CSP directives, frame-ancestors among them, are ignored when the policy arrives in a meta element, because the browser cannot apply them after the document has started parsing. A team that writes frame-ancestors in a meta tag therefore believes it has blocked framing while every origin can still embed the page.
applicability: Responses that deliver a Content-Security-Policy through a meta element.
risk: The page remains embeddable by any origin, which enables clickjacking and UI redressing against authenticated users despite the declared policy.
